hand_moves.what: Title card 'Rules' overlays the first 5.6 s; the 15 balls are already lined up and the cue ball is placed (ball in hand, per the card). Nothing visible about how they were placed.

Hard video cut between run A (after ball 15 potted) and run B: the table is back to a full row of 15 balls in numerical order with the cue ball placed top-left. The re-rack is not shown. This is a re-set mid-video and would break a tracker's ball-count continuity.

No ball was moved by hand between shots within a run: the cue ball rests where it stopped and the next shot is taken from there (checked: rest position of the cue ball before each shot equals its stop position within ~1 px at 640 wide).

labeller_notes: Two runs of the same drill (shoot balls 1..15 in order, cue ball never in hand after the first shot): run A t=8.85..114, 15 shots, all potted; run B t=118..222, 15 shots, all potted. 30 shots, 30 balls potted, no scratch, no foul. Ball identification is by position in the starting row (left to right = 1..15, numerically ordered, 8 black in 8th place) and by colour: in this set 4 is pink, 5 purple, 6 green, 7 orange, 8 black, stripes 9..15 same colours with a band (the brief's colour list says 4 purple/5 orange/7 maroon, which does not match this set; the row order is what I used). Stripes 12, 13, 14 show a lot of dark ring from above and look near-black/pink-dark. First contact: in every shot only the target ball (the lowest ball left in the row) moved after the cue ball reached it and nothing else moved; I saw the cue ball adjacent to the target at 4 fps (0.25 s) spacing, not frame by frame, so contact is 'seen', pocket names are approximate and the exact contact frame is not stated. t_start = first frame the cue ball moves (measured with a cream-colour blob tracker on the cue ball, confirmed by eye on 4-10 fps contact sheets; accuracy about +/-0.1 s). t_end = first time the cue ball has moved less than ~1 px (of 1280) over 0.5 s after the pot; the cue ball creeps slowly for a few seconds on some shots, so t_end could be 0.5-1 s earlier than the last visible creep. potted_at is an extra field: the time the ball is first seen in/at the pocket, approx +/-0.25 s. The video was an edited clip: the first 5.6 s is a title card (balls and cue ball visible through it, cue ball not detectable).
